nodes.name: Section — Triggers — one Normalize for every entry

parameters.content:
## Triggers — one Normalize for every entry
09:00 daily (acts on Mondays and the last weekday), 03:00 canvas, and requests from Workflow 2 (digest / refresh). Normalize Request sets the mode and which branch runs, and holds the recipient and canvas lists.

## Monday digest DM — leadership
Summary tables to the five leadership recipients (or just the asker on request). Sends one at a time, and Check Sent fails loudly on any Slack error.

nodes.name: Section — Month-end nudge — one DM per engineer

parameters.content:
## Month-end nudge — one DM per engineer
Last weekday of the month: each engineer gets their open list, and each message ts becomes notify_ts so a 🚀 on it releases.

## Tracker canvases — nightly 03:00 + "refresh"
Rewrites every leadership DM's Tracker canvas in full. Check Canvas fails on any ok:false.

## Workflow 3 — Weekly Digest

Reads the index only — zero Slack history calls.

### Two ways in, one code path
* **Schedule** — daily 09:00 Manila trigger,
  gated by `Normalize Request` into two cadences:
  * **Digest** — every **Monday**, to leadership
    (regie, tara, edith, vic, lyn). Gate: `Should
    Digest` on `run_digest`.
  * **Engineer nudges** — the **last weekday of
    the month**, one DM per engineer with open
    work. Gate: `Is Month-End Run` on
    `run_reminders`.
* **Execute Workflow** — someone DMs Posty
  "digest" -> manual, requester only, any day.

### DM + canvas (2026-09-25)
Monday DM: summary tables — headline numbers,
released this week, releases and open projects
per engineer — and a button to the Tracker.
Tracker canvas (in each leadership DM): every list,
full tables. `Canvas — 03:00` rewrites all of
them nightly; Tara can DM "refresh" any time.

### Buckets
`120+` / `90-119` / `60-89` / `30-59`; `<30`
counted, not listed. DELETED & CANCELLED excluded.

### Released this month
The list is month-to-date (release_date's
YYYY-MM). The scoreboard's "Released this week"
count stays 7-day, so Net backlog is week vs week.

### Long sections split
Slack caps a text block at 5,000 chars. Sections
split across messages rather than dropping rows.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.user, text: $json.text, blocks: $json.blocks, unfurl_links: false, unfurl_media: false, metadata: { event_type: 'posty_digest', event_payload: { as_of: $('Normalize Request').first().json.as_of } } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
// The nightly canvas refresh, an hour after the 02:00 index update so it reads fresh rows.
return [{ json: { canvas: true } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ canvas_id: $json.canvas_id, changes: [{ operation: 'replace', document_content: { type: 'markdown', markdown: $json.markdown } }] }) }}
